description:
What is This Part?
These are the Leaf Spring Shackles & Bushes for the Front & Rear Leaf Springs
Comes with Shackle Pins & Bolts plus the Rubber Bush’s
Complete 4 Shackle Set Does Entire Samurai
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 4 – Shackles
Qty 8 – Pins
Qty 8 – Nuts
Qty 16 – Rubber Bush
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
